summary: Spotify Loop Container, 100% Bilingual Parity, Zero-Reboot Module Sync & Adaptive I/O Booster Stability.
changelog:
✨ Added:
• Spotify Private Data Loop Container (.img) resolving SELinux & SQLite permission issues
• Zero-Loss streaming data migration pipeline directly into loop containers
• Zero-reboot silent module sync & live daemon reload on APK update
• Automated watchdog revival guard protecting daemon from low-memory kills

🚀 Improved:
• 100% strict bilingual parity (1,170 keys in EN & ID) eliminating language leaks
• Adaptive I/O Booster stability across eMMC, low/high-class MicroSD, SSD & UFS storage
• Kernel BDI target filtering protecting zram swap and preventing memory bloat
• High-performance parallel warmup reducing cold-start latency

🎨 UI/UX & Fixed:
• Dynamic external storage media titles (MicroSD / USB / Internal)
• Resolved horizontal pager index crash and restored smooth page indicators
• Verified Play Store live app updates (Genshin Impact 7.2.0, 18 mount points intact)
• Default English language on fresh install with full changelog scrolling
